name: Bitdeer high-tech computing/data center opportunities in Turkmenistan
notes: Bitdeer presented at CIET-2025 in Avaza, Balkan, and expressed interest in establishing high-tech computing centers/data centres in Turkmenistan using stable energy resources. No specific site, capacity, or committed build schedule was disclosed.

name: National Data Processing Center and AI Development Center program
developer: Ministry of Communications of Turkmenistan / Turkmentelecom
notes: The communications minister announced plans to build a national data processing center and create an AI Development Center on the basis of Turkmentelecom under the 2026-2028 digital economy program. The ministry is headquartered in Ashgabat; the source does not identify a separate physical site or capacity.

name: Ministry of Communications-Muroosystems data center construction and modernization MoU
developer: Ministry of Communications of Turkmenistan; Muroosystems Corporation
notes: MoU covers establishing and modernizing data centers in Turkmenistan, including constructing new data centers to international digital-infrastructure standards. Article does not state site count, exact locations, capacity, or schedule; assigned to Ashgabat because the ministry is Ashgabat-based.

name: High-performance computing and cryptocurrency mining data centers program
developer: Ministry of Energy of Turkmenistan / foreign companies TBD
notes: Energy minister Annageldi Saparov said Turkmenistan is in preliminary negotiations with specialized international companies to develop modern data centers for high-performance computing and cryptocurrency projects using surplus electricity. Announcement was made at the White City Ashgabat 2026 conference; no project sites or capacities disclosed.
